company_name: Shanghai Dongxu Electronic Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor materials and wafer processing services, making it a key player in the supply chain.
summary: Shanghai Dongxu Electronic Technology Co., Ltd is a semiconductor materials supplier based in Japan, focusing on the R&D and manufacturing of essential materials such as adhesive tapes and wafers. They provide a comprehensive range of wafer processing services and customized solutions to meet the demands of various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Manufacturing of adhesive tapes for semiconductor applications
Supply of wafers from Dummy to Prime grades, ranging from 1-12 inches
Provision of special insulating films and metal films
